changeSet.sql: ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Asset_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Asset] AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Object], [ObjectID], [Custom], AssetID) select 'Update', I.Object, I.ObjectID, [queue].WriteIndexXml('', I.[Object], I.ObjectID, coalesce(I.UpdatedBy, 0)), I.ID from inserted I where I.Object not in('FusionAttribute','FusionQueryAttribute','Resource');
